candidate_windows.window_text: ZS-CoDR is developed using PyTorch $^{3}$ , a Python-based deep learning package. We utilize the different LLM models imported from the Hugging Face Transformers $^{4}$ package for our experiments. All experiments are conducted on an NVIDIA Tesla V100-PCIE GPU. Pre-training is carried out for 7 epochs, followed by fine-tuning for 4 epochs. Optimization is performed using the Adam optimizer (Kingma and Ba, 2015), with learning rates set to 0.0003 and 0.005, and exponential decay rates (beta) of (0.9,0.999) for both tasks.
